documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — market-map
documents.text: Synthetic territory North data as of 2026-10-08: therapy N-Standard is approved and current standard of care; N-Clinical is in phase 2 and targets K; N-Alternative is approved with a different mechanism; N-Stopped was discontinued because the sponsor lost funding, not because efficacy failed. The target population is adults with disease N after standard therapy. Clinical eligibility is adults with biomarker K and adequate organ function. Prevalence is 100000, eligible fraction 0.20, access fraction 0.50. N-Standard list price is USD 12000 per patient per year; this is not a proposed price for the candidate. Reimbursement covers the eligible subgroup; prescribing requires a specialist. A patient survey reports unmet need but does not establish willingness to pay. No head-to-head advantage of the candidate has been demonstrated.
